title: Matrices still apply at every location, fixed prices per location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use a staging client with two locations, location 1 and location 2.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test with the same part number at both locations, category A, cost $10.00, fixed sell price $12.50 at location 1 only.
  • Have two new work orders for this test for customer B, work order 1 at location 1 and work order 2 at location 2.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Add the inventory part from the catalog search.
  3. Switch to location 2.
  4. Open work order 2.
  5. Add the inventory part from the catalog search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The part reads $12.50 at location 1.

Step 3:

  • Location 2 is current.

Step 4:

  • Work order 2 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 5:

  • The part reads $13.50 at location 2 ($10.00 × 1.35), category A's matrix price.
